answer: Every agent locks a dedicated 24 GB RAM array and walks pseudo-random cache lines under a cryptographic seal, so one identity cannot be cloned across virtual machines. The verifier sends a grove task: the agent must visit the sealed offsets in order and return the crystal result within a 40 millisecond budget. One honest agent runs 1 traversal on 24 GB of RAM costing $180; 10 fakes must hold 240 GB and complete 10 umber traversals at once. Peers check the public access log and slash the bond of any agent whose proof fails to verify, freezing repeat offenders.
